closing.summary: Big strengths are omega 3, protein, and vitamin B12, but the biggest weaknesses are low iron, low vitamin D, and low collagen. It is good for blood and oxygen support, hormone health, and low-calorie volume because vitamin B12 supports the blood-and-oxygen side, the fat section has enough useful fats for a support role, and it can add bulk or fullness without much calorie pressure.
